rationale: Price is at 88.7% of today's range and sitting right at the session high ($19.09) after a large gap-up and strong intraday run, with the 9-EMA providing immediate support but no clear momentum continuation signal — the last five 1-minute candles show a slow grind higher on declining volume, suggesting exhaustion rather than breakout. With only 65 minutes to close and the stock already extended well above VWAP ($18.36), the risk/reward for a long is poor (limited upside to $19.09 high, meaningful downside), while a short against a strong news-driven trend with positive analyst coverage carries equal risk. No high-conviction setup exists in either direction.
